This role performs hands-on administration of servers, user access, and system configurations while ensuring compliance with operational and security policies. Configure and validate backup and recovery solutions to ensure data protection and continuity for critical systems and applications. Analyze system logs and metrics to detect anomalies, performance degradation, and potential security incidents, escalating and remediating as needed. Required Qualifications Requires a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in IT, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related field. At least 4 years of enterprise system administration and automation experience, typically 3-6 years in a systems administrator or related infrastructure role. Demonstrated experience managing Windows and/or Linux servers, user accounts, permissions, and group policies in an enterprise environment. Hands-on experience with system monitoring, patch management, backup and recovery, and troubleshooting of hardware and software issues. Strong proficiency with scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, or Python) for task automation and operational improvements. Must meet DoD 8140 requirements (Security+ certification) and hold an active Secret clearance. Must be a US Citizen.   Preferred Qualifications DoD 8140-compliant certification such as Security+ or equivalent. Experience with virtualization or cloud platforms (e.g., VMware, AWS, Azure). Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform) and modern automation frameworks. Experience supporting 24/7 operations, including incident response and on-call participation in a mission-critical environment.   salary range: $80,000-$110,000  #cjpost

Must have a current Cisco Certified Networking Professional (CCNP) certification. Minimum High School Diploma/GED.
